statement.text:
Suppose that a is a non-trivial element of a finite group G such that |CG (a)| ⩾
|CG (x)| for every non-trivial element x ∈ G, and let H be a nilpotent subgroup of G
which is normalized by CG (a). Is it true that H ⩽ CG (a)? This is true if H is abelian,
or if H is a p′ -group for some prime number p ∈ π(Z(CG (a))).
                                                    I. T. Mukhamet’yanov, A. N. Fomin
